input.name: toRoman
input.task: Convert an integer n from 1 to 3999 to a Roman numeral in standard subtractive form (4 is IV, 9 is IX, 40 is XL).

input.name: isPalindrome
input.task: Return true when s reads the same forwards and backwards after you remove every character that is not a letter or a digit and ignore case. An empty string is a palindrome.

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

input.name: flatten
input.task: Flatten an array that can hold numbers and arrays nested to any depth into one flat array of numbers, in order. Do not use Array.prototype.flat.

input.name: wordCount
input.task: Count words in text. A word is a run of the letters a to z, compared without case; every other character separates words. Return an object that maps each lowercase word to its count. Empty text gives an empty object.

input.name: mergeIntervals
input.task: Given an array of [start, end] pairs in any order, merge every pair that overlaps or touches (end equal to the next start) and return the merged pairs sorted by start.

input.name: parseDuration
input.task: Parse a duration such as "1h30m", "45s" or "1h2m3s" into a total number of seconds. Units are h, m and s; each appears at most once, in that order, and any of them can be missing.

input.name: lcsLength
input.task: Return the length of the longest common subsequence of strings a and b (characters in the same order, not necessarily next to each other).

input.name: primesUpTo
input.task: Return every prime number less than or equal to n, in increasing order. For n below 2, return an empty array.
